ticker_news.title: 2 Unstoppable Growth Stocks That Could Soar 20% and 26% in 2026, According to Wall Street Analysts
ticker_news.description: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing (TSM) and ASML Holding (ASML) are highlighted as resilient growth stocks that have outperformed during market downturns. TSM, with 70% foundry market share, posted strong Q1 earnings with 35% YoY revenue growth and has 98% analyst buy ratings with a $456 price target (20% upside). ASML, a semiconductor equipment maker, reported 13% YoY revenue growth and raised guidance, with 82% analyst buy ratings and a $1,775 price target (26% upside). However, TSMC's announcement to delay purchasing ASML's next-generation machines until 2029 could impact ASML's future earnings.
ticker_news.author: Dave Kovaleski

SPY.title: The S&P 500's Next Shock May Come From Another Country — And It's Not Iran
SPY.description: The Bank of Japan's upcoming policy decision poses a significant risk to global markets, particularly the S&P 500. A potential rate hike or hawkish messaging could strengthen the yen, forcing investors to unwind the massive yen carry trade that has leveraged global equities and bonds. Additionally, Japan's large holdings of U.S. Treasuries could be repatriated if domestic yields rise, putting upward pressure on U.S. yields and tightening financial conditions.
SPY.author: Stjepan Kalinic

SPY.title: This ’Safe’ Retirement Strategy Is Costly and This 10% Dividend Crushes It
SPY.description: The article argues that overly conservative retirement strategies like savings accounts and Treasury bonds deliver poor long-term returns, potentially extending working years by decades. It advocates for higher-return stock investments, particularly highlighting closed-end funds with high dividend yields like Liberty All-Star Equity Fund (USA) as a better alternative that provides regular cash income without forcing investors to sell during market downturns.
SPY.author: Michael Foster

SPY.title: Stock Market Today: Dow Futures Fall, S&P 500 Gains As Trump Halts Iran Talks— Organon, SAP, Cheetah Net Supply Chain Service In Focus (UPDATED)
SPY.description: U.S. stock futures fell on Monday as President Trump canceled Iran talks, citing divisions within Tehran. The market awaits the Federal Reserve's Wednesday meeting with 100% likelihood of unchanged rates. Key movers include Organon jumping 15% on a $11.75B acquisition deal, SAP rising 6.14% on cloud adoption acceleration, and Cheetah Net plummeting 22.12% following a reverse stock split announcement.
SPY.author: Rishabh Mishra
